page_title: MON 5-2 BOC | B. Monchengladbach v Bochum 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' 5 - 2 Goal! Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top right corner. He makes it 5:2.
90+6' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+5' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Manuel Riemann makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Good work from B. Monchengladbach as they win a corner.
90+2' A sweet pass inside the box gives Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' The substitution has been made. Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) has replaced Stefan Lainer.
88' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Tony Jantschke (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Jordan Siebatcheu.

88' 4 - 2 Matus Bero sends a superb cross into the box. Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) latches on to it and from close range plants a header in off the bottom of the left post, leaving Moritz Nicolas beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 4:2.
87' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
87' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum). The referee blows his whistle, Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
84' 4:5 – the corner kicks stats.
82' Here's the change. Nathan Ngoumou leaves the pitch and Christoph Kramer (B. Monchengladbach) comes on as a substitute.

78' 4 - 1 Franck Honorat showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the middle of the goal. It's 4:1.
77' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) wastes a golden opportunity from inside the six-yard box after firing the ball a few inches over the crossbar.
75' 3 - 1 Goal! Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:1.
72' 3 - 0 Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) rises high to get on the end of a cross and scores with a very lucky header after the ball goes into the middle of the goal!
69' Moritz Broschinski goes off the pitch and Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) comes on.
69' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Erhan Masovic leaves the pitch and Goncalo Paciencia (Bochum) comes on.
67' Gerardo Seoane decides to make a substitution. Florian Neuhaus will be replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Robin Hack as he is replaced by Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach).
66' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
65' The attendance is 53000.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Keven Schlotterbeck (Bochum) was quite harsh and Frank Willenborg didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
63' The linesman signals that Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
58' Thomas Letsch has decided to substitute Cristian Gamboa and he is replaced by Philipp Forster (Bochum).
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lukas Daschner (Bochum) comes onto the pitch for Moritz-Broni Kwarteng.
58' Bochum can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
58' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Bochum will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

56' What a miss! Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
53' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bochum comes to nothing.

53' Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Moritz Nicolas. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bochum are going to take it.
53' Bochum have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Takuma Asano (Bochum) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bochum.
48' The resulting set piece from Bochum is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

48' Takuma Asano (Bochum) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play. Bochum are awarded a corner kick.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Frank Willenborg blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+4' Kevin Stoger (Bochum) uses the wrong choice of words while trying to explain something to the referee and receives a yellow card for dissent.
45+4' Manuel Riemann (Bochum) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Frank Willenborg's book.
45+4' It must be a yellow card. It is. Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
45+1' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45+1' The goal by B. Monchengladbach is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
45+1' Wait! Referee Frank Willenborg has indicated he is going to review the B. Monchengladbach goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
42' 10:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
39' Takuma Asano (Bochum) challenges for the lofted pass into the centre of the box, but has to stretch too much and sends his header narrowly wide of the left post.
37' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
36' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and B. Monchengladbach manage to earn a corner.
35' 2 - 0 Goal! Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Manuel Riemann into the top left corner.
34' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.

32' The game is interrupted. Ivan Ordets (Bochum) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a penalty for B. Monchengladbach!
30' Erhan Masovic (Bochum) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Frank Willenborg had an easy-decision to make.

28' 1 - 0 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the right post. The score changes to 1:0.
28' The ball is out of play. B. Monchengladbach win a corner kick.
28' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
26' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and Frank Willenborg immediately signals a free kick.
23' That was close by Moritz Broschinski (Bochum)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes inches wide of the left post.
22' Bochum control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
20' A shot from the edge of the box by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) is close, but lifts narrowly over the bar at the last second.
18' Florian Neuhaus (B. Monchengladbach) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
14' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) sends the corner into the box, but Manuel Riemann intercepts it and averts the threat.

14' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
11' B. Monchengladbach take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

11' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to B. Monchengladbach.

8' Crossbar! Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header from around the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball crashed against the bar!
6' Celebrations are cut short for Bochum as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
6' Wait! Referee Frank Willenborg has indicated he is going to review the Bochum goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a handball in the build-up.
4' Bernardo (Bochum) scores as the ball bounces off his body. He was standing in front of goal and helped his team with a lucky deflection.
4' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bochum.

4' Moritz-Broni Kwarteng (Bochum) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bochum will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Bochum will take the kick-off.
Frank Willenborg will officiate today.
